messages:
maria: running an end-to-end restore for a large tenant snapshot (2TB) — midway it failed with decrypt denied when fetching final blobs
maria: error: `AccessDeniedException: InvalidGrantTokenException: grant is not valid or expired`
sam: weird. did the grant service revoke earlier than expected? we set ephemeral grants to 5m by default last quarter
ash: check the restore timeline. long restores now stream in parts; initial chunks used grant fine but final stage started ~7m after CreateGrant
backup-ops: looking at the grant issuance logs 021-07-12T10:05:23Z `CreateGrant` issued with grantId=gr-01a, ttlSeconds=300
maria: that matches the 5m TTL. our restore pipeline opens concurrent download workers and can take 10-20m for big snapshots depending on throttling
sam: that's an oversight. we assumed restores would complete under TTL because of caching. misses when downloads get rate-limited or cross-region pulled
ash: recommend change: either increase grant TTL for restore-runner to 30m, or implement grant-refresh: if remaining work > 60s, call CreateGrant refresh before expiry
backup-ops: quick mitigation: bump default ephemeral TTL to 1800s for restore role and re-run the staging restore
maria: forensics: audit query I ran: `fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.grantId | filter eventName = "CreateGrant" and userIdentity.arn like "%restore-runner%"`
ash: also found `RevokeGrant` events for older grants but not during this window; seems the grant just aged out, not explicitly revoked
sam: post-mortem items: 1) update rotation docs and grant TTL policy 2) add instrumentation to restore-runner to surface grant expiry time in logs 3) make restore pipeline idempotent so it can renew grant and resume
maria: temporary alert rule idea: if restore duration > grant_ttl_seconds * 0.8, raise warn on ops channel
ash: add unit test in grant-service: simulate long-running restore and ensure refresh path exercised
backup-ops: confirmed after TTL bump to 1800s manual re-run completed end-to-end, integrity checks passed :white_check_mark:
sec-bot: Incident recorded (id=ir-2026-03-21-02). Reminder: attach grant logs and S3 object manifests to ticket for audit retention
maria: opening follow-up ticket and will ping infra to land TTL change and restore-side refresh logic. leaving thread for 48h for any late artifacts
